groups.rationale: ADR-0240 adds three Accounts User preference groups to chapter 21 without adding domains, resources or services. Preserve the integrated fleet topology and native recovery evidence from upstream.

Chapters 03, 07, 08, 19, 20 and 21 document self-only presets, initial OSS/Work profiles, draft retention, original-request launch replay and refusals. Record 92 application checks and scoped Chromium evidence separately from pending native/rollout acceptance; preserve upstream Android and Windows evidence.

Presets retain standard/oss wire values, shape bounds and source2 identity. Shared chapters add account/browser evidence only and preserve upstream native recovery records; no protocol source is changed by this task.

The task changes initial Marshall admission inputs only. Integrated Lilly Android relay policy is retained; presets alter no host fence, capacity, storage, networking or native isolation authority. Current preset native execution remains pending.

No service, SSH, agent or notification authority changes in this task. Shared chapters preserve upstream custody/transport evidence while distinguishing browser preference resolution from service enforcement.

The revised default-profile browser fixture saves/reloads an OSS preset before the existing native policy journey. Coverage keeps native execution pending and historical results scoped, while recording disposable Chromium checks. Preserve upstream fleet placement and FreeBSD/Windows acceptance boundaries.

ADR-0240 documents account presets and narrowly amends ADR-0147/0157/0196. The review and scenario ledger record passing scoped execution, existing type/full-suite/font limitations and native gaps; upstream ADR-0235/0237 and their evidence remain intact.
